notes.subject: כנענים
notes.rationale: Tupela rit: 'ol Kenaan man' o 'ol man i salim ol long olgeta hap' (כנעני i save tok olsem moni-man) — mipela i holim dalim tu, YLT i olsem.

notes.subject: ספרד
notes.rationale: Sefarad i kamap long Tanakh long dispela ves tasol; ples i no klia — Sardis o Sefarad (Ispania).

notes.subject: ol ples bilong kalabus
notes.rationale: Tsen Tsiyon i tok long hap graun we ol kalabus i stap — dispela ves i hat tumas long ol man i tanim tok.

translation: Na ol man i kalabus — dispela ami bilong ol pikinini man bilong Yisrael, ol i stap olsem ol man i salim ol long olgeta hap inap long Tsarefat — na ol man i kalabus bilong Yerusalayim, ol i stap long Sefarad, bai ol i kisim ⟨את⟩ ol taun bilong saut.

tokens.gloss: olsem ol man i salim ol long olgeta hap
na ol man i kalabus bilong
